verdict.rationale: Trello offers visual board-based task tracking, templates, automation, and a Jira-list Power-Up. Community users describe Idea→Doing→Done feature workflows and call it a step up from Pivotal Tracker, so it can loosely support agile work. However, nothing in the evidence shows dedicated sprint constructs, and one user left for Zenhub for software development. Missing for 10: sprint/iteration creation and scheduling, backlog grooming, story points/estimation, velocity or burndown reporting, and first-party agile/scrum documentation.
